channel.title: 0X1
channel.description: Malware analysis, reverse engineering, threat intelligence and detection research by BlackXero1.

item.title: From Click to C2
item.description: One ClickFix paste, seven encryption layers, a fully decrypted C2 conversation, and a fake Google Drive extension that forges Chrome's own protection to become a file-stealing, command-running backdoor.

item.title: Born in the Kernel
item.description: Nine signed, vulnerable kernel drivers loaded on a patched Windows 10 VM with Defender on: seven loaded unopposed, a common Sysmon tuning hid them all, and tested YARA rules with clean-set false-positive numbers.

item.title: The Loader Is the Malware
item.description: 31 side-loading samples and 8 live detonations: how Mustang Panda, MuddyWater and commodity crews hide inside signed Windows programs, a reversed RtlRegisterWait loader shared across four hosts, and a tested detection scorecard.

item.title: Six Locks, No Key
item.description: Reversing a Go dropper's six-step inline payload decryption with GoReSym, capstone and Python, then statically unpacking a novel infostealer without running it.

item.title: Memory Tells the Truth
item.description: Five fileless and in-memory techniques, one RAM dump each: what survives in volatile memory when the disk is clean, and how to recover it with Volatility 3.

item.title: EDR Evasion: Layers, Live
item.description: Anti-analysis, hook removal, syscall resolution, process injection and cryptography, implemented in C++ and tested against a live Windows 10 target.

item.title: ClickFix: Two Chains, One Technique
item.description: Two live ClickFix campaigns: an AES PowerShell chain to a custom Go infostealer, and an MSI VBScript chain to a WebRTC C2 implant. Full chain RE, YARA, Sigma, IOCs.

item.title: Nine Front Doors, One Toolkit
item.description: Bitter / TA397 across 20 samples, 10 delivery formats and 6 C2 protocols: a developer fingerprint, a corrected MiyaRAT beacon and Pakistani operator infrastructure.

item.title: The Cat-and-Mouse Game
item.description: EDR evasion seen from the defender's side: what each technique blinds, what telemetry still survives, and how to correlate it into detections.
